versions.content: Handling if Eth_MacSecUpdateRxSa is called with Active is set to FALSE , the secured association is disabled and EthCtrlMacSecEnabled of the addressed EthCtrlConfig is set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If Eth_MacSecUpdateRxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthCtrlMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthCtrlConfig identified with the given CtrlIdx • the given API parameter Active is set to FALSE • the reception secured association given with An exists and is disabled then the Eth driver shall ignore the API call and return with E_OK . Otherwise, if the addressed reception secured association does not exist, return with E_NOT_OK .
